title_zh: 为小场地演出安排中途休息

scenario.label_zh: 安排乐队演出的中场休息
scenario.goal_zh: 依据演出时长与演奏强度确定休息长度和恢复演出的提示

context_zh: 乐队成员在小酒馆演出前和场地经理核对安排。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: How long is our gig on Friday? The email just says eight until ten.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: That includes an interval. You don't have to play for two hours without a break.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Good. The last section is quite intense, and our drummer needs time to recover.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Would a fifteen-minute break after the first set work?

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Yes. We'll finish that set at eight forty-five.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Then I'll announce that you're back at nine and lower the background music when you're ready.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Perfect. I'll give you a nod from the stage before we start again.
